厦门高崎.source_text_en: Other threats: (1) The northeast side of the airport borders Kinmen Island, which is relatively close to this airport and requires strict adherence to flight restrictions specified in the airworthiness chart. There have been frequent GPS signal interference incidents near Xiamen Airport, with other airlines repeatedly issuing GPWS warnings due to GPS signal interference.

上海虹桥.text_en: Hongqiao Airport employs the SASAN Point Merge arrival procedure. For arrivals via SASAN, crews should select the appropriate transition (ESBAG/ZJ/PIMOL) based on the flight plan and LID information. Upon firstcontact with approach control, crews should report the arrival/transition/approach/runway information per the LID information.

上海虹桥.source_text_en: SASAN Point Merge procedure: inner arc (ESBAG direction) altitude ≥5400 m; outer arc (PIMOL/ZJ direction) altitude ≤5100 m; speed limit AT 260 kt.Aircraft on SS603-SASAN shall not deviate east of track without clearance; when airspace restrictions apply, descend to 3600 m–4800 m prior to 15 KM from SASAN.

上海虹桥.source_text_en: For SASAN arrivals, altitude should normally be not lower than 3600 m prior to passing Suzhou (approximately 40 NM from the SHA VOR); subsequently the SS420 altitude constraint must be met. Crews should pay attention to altitude and speed control.

上海虹桥.source_text_en: Hongqiao Airport will implement the Taxiway A / K1 Junction Supplementary Pavement Renovation Project. During Phases 1 and 2 (planned 1 September 2026 – 31 October 2026), flights parked/serviced inthe East Area thatfail tovacate via Taxiway A2 in a timely manner will have to taxi back via Taxiways B3 and B2 along Taxiway B, crossing the east runway via H4; or via Taxiway B1 along H2 and Taxiway C, crossing the west runway via H4, then Taxiway B and the east runway to return.

上海虹桥.source_text_zh: 进场：虹桥机场将实施 A 滑 K1 道口增补面改造项目，一、二阶段（计划 2026 年9 月 1 日-2026 年 10 月 31 日），降落东区保障的航班若未及时使用 A2 脱离，将绕行返回，通过 B3、B2 沿 B 滑、H4 穿东跑道返回；或通过 B1 沿 H2、C 滑、H4 穿西跑道、B 滑、东跑道返回。

上海虹桥.source_text_en: Regarding the Visual Docking Guidance System (VDGS/A-VDGS) at Hongqiao Airport bridges: as the aircraftapproaches the stop line,the distance readout decreases rapidly and may suddenly jump to "STOP." Crews should control the docking speed—within the last 10 m, control speed so that "SLOW" does not appear on the guidance display; within the last5 m, ensure the aircraft can be stopped at any time to avoid crossing the stop line.

zh.source_text_en: SASAN Point Merge procedure: inner arc (ESBAG direction) altitude ≥5400 m; outer arc (PIMOL/ZJ direction) altitude ≤5100 m; speed limit AT 260 kt.Aircraft on SS603-SASAN shall not deviate east of track without clearance; when airspace restrictions apply, descend to 3600 m–4800 m prior to 15 KM from SASAN.

zh.source_text_en: Hongqiao Airport will implement the Taxiway A / K1 Junction Supplementary Pavement Renovation Project. During Phases 1 and 2 (planned 1 September 2026 – 31 October 2026), flights parked/serviced inthe East Area thatfail tovacate via Taxiway A2 in a timely manner will have to taxi back via Taxiways B3 and B2 along Taxiway B, crossing the east runway via H4; or via Taxiway B1 along H2 and Taxiway C, crossing the west runway via H4, then Taxiway B and the east runway to return.

zh.source_text_en: Regarding the Visual Docking Guidance System (VDGS/A-VDGS) at Hongqiao Airport bridges: as the aircraftapproaches the stop line,the distance readout decreases rapidly and may suddenly jump to "STOP." Crews should control the docking speed—within the last 10 m, control speed so that "SLOW" does not appear on the guidance display; within the last5 m, ensure the aircraft can be stopped at any time to avoid crossing the stop line.

On the Xiamen-Nanyang route, the flight sequence may be directed as follows: QO, then P48, followed by P263, JDZ, and finally XSH.

Upon firstcontact with approach control, crews should report the arrival/transition/approach/runway information per the LID information.

厦门高崎.source_text_en: If Runway 05 ILS fails,the crew may initiate RNP 05 approach. Note that the arrival gate number differs. Additionally, when RNP approaches Runway 05 and the AP is disconnected at the minimum descent altitude, the profile tends to be elevated. Control measures: ①Prepare contingency plans in the briefing, and execute a decisive go-around ifan unstable approach occurs; Ifthe drop rate exceeds 1000 feet, the PM must issue a warning. ②During operation, ifthe altitude profile ishigher than expected after visual check, stabilize the descent point, then check the descent rate. If the rate is within 1000 feet per minute, continue the approach; otherwise, return tothe runway. ③ Xiamen now requires that both the covered bridge and passenger elevators must be removed and fully prepared before reporting. On the Xiamen-Nanyang route, the flight sequence may be directed as follows: QO, then P48, followed by P263, JDZ, and finally XSH.

上海虹桥.source_text_en: Phase 2 (planned 1–31 October), construction inAreas A and B, operational impacts: a. Taxiways A1, K1, and T1 closed; Taxiway H1 between RWY 18L/36R and Taxiway A closed; Taxiway A between Taxiway A2 and Taxiway H1 closed; Taxiway L01 north of Stand 315 closed. b. A temporary Taxiway Category C taxi guideline will be established (relocating the original Taxiway L01 north of Stand 315 eastward by 20 m), available exclusively to aircraft with wingspan less than 36 m, with temporary edge lightsinstalled.

上海虹桥.source_text_en: Hongqiao Airport employs the SASAN Point Merge arrival procedure. For arrivals via SASAN, crews should select the appropriate transition (ESBAG/ZJ/PIMOL) based on the flight plan and LID information. Upon firstcontact with approach control, crews should report the arrival/transition/approach/runway information per the LID information.

上海虹桥.source_text_en: SASAN Point Merge procedure: inner arc (ESBAG direction) altitude ≥5400 m; outer arc (PIMOL/ZJ direction) altitude ≤5100 m; speed limit AT 260 kt.Aircraft on SS603-SASAN shall not deviate east of track without clearance; when airspace restrictions apply, descend to 3600 m–4800 m prior to 15 KM from SASAN.

上海虹桥.source_text_en: Hongqiao Airport will implement the Taxiway A / K1 Junction Supplementary Pavement Renovation Project. During Phases 1 and 2 (planned 1 September 2026 – 31 October 2026), flights parked/serviced inthe East Area thatfail tovacate via Taxiway A2 in a timely manner will have to taxi back via Taxiways B3 and B2 along Taxiway B, crossing the east runway via H4; or via Taxiway B1 along H2 and Taxiway C, crossing the west runway via H4, then Taxiway B and the east runway to return.

上海虹桥.source_text_en: Regarding the Visual Docking Guidance System (VDGS/A-VDGS) at Hongqiao Airport bridges: as the aircraftapproaches the stop line,the distance readout decreases rapidly and may suddenly jump to "STOP." Crews should control the docking speed—within the last 10 m, control speed so that "SLOW" does not appear on the guidance display; within the last5 m, ensure the aircraft can be stopped at any time to avoid crossing the stop line.

厦门高崎.source_text_en: In exceptional circumstances, any deviation towards the coast isstrictly prohibited. Pilots must strictly follow ground instructions to avoid entering airspace over islands such as the Greater and Lesser Kinmen Islands. For Runway 23, ATC may designate departure points. Strict adherence to speed limits is mandatory, and the flight plan explicitly prohibits eastward deviations, with non-compliance subject to penalties.

厦门高崎.source_text_en: During the 05 approach, maintain the correct course at the five-point approach point without eastward deviation, and strictlycontrol the timing and altitude for passing the outer reference beacon (D4.5XMN) and the XLN (Crossing Point) navigation station. When the airfield islightly trafficked and the tower isoperating autonomously, strictly follow the descent altitude specified in the approach chart. Aircraft entering from the west should promptly slow down and request altitude reduction.

zh.source_text_en: Hongqiao Airport employs the SASAN Point Merge arrival procedure. For arrivals via SASAN, crews should select the appropriate transition (ESBAG/ZJ/PIMOL) based on the flight plan and LID information. zh.source_text_en: SASAN Point Merge procedure: inner arc (ESBAG direction) altitude ≥5400 m; outer arc (PIMOL/ZJ direction) altitude ≤5100 m; speed limit AT 260 kt.Aircraft on SS603-SASAN shall not deviate east of track without clearance; when airspace restrictions apply, descend to 3600 m–4800 m prior to 15 KM from SASAN.

zh.source_text_en: Hongqiao Airport will implement the Taxiway A / K1 Junction Supplementary Pavement Renovation Project. During Phases 1 and 2 (planned 1 September 2026 – 31 October 2026), flights parked/serviced inthe East Area thatfail tovacate via Taxiway A2 in a timely manner will have to taxi back via Taxiways B3 and B2 along Taxiway B, crossing the east runway via H4; or via Taxiway B1 along H2 and Taxiway C, crossing the west runway via H4, then Taxiway B and the east runway to return.

zh.source_text_en: Regarding the Visual Docking Guidance System (VDGS/A-VDGS) at Hongqiao Airport bridges: as the aircraftapproaches the stop line,the distance readout decreases rapidly and may suddenly jump to "STOP." Crews should control the docking speed—within the last 10 m, control speed so that "SLOW" does not appear on the guidance display; within the last5 m, ensure the aircraft can be stopped at any time to avoid crossing the stop line.

zh.source_text_en: In exceptional circumstances, any deviation towards the coast isstrictly prohibited. Pilots must strictly follow ground instructions to avoid entering airspace over islands such as the Greater and Lesser Kinmen Islands. For Runway 23, ATC may designate departure points. Aircraft entering from the west should promptly slow down and request altitude reduction.

en.source_text_en: If Runway 05 ILS fails,the crew may initiate RNP 05 approach. Note that the arrival gate number differs. Additionally, when RNP approaches Runway 05 and the AP is disconnected at the minimum descent altitude, the profile tends to be elevated. Control measures: ①Prepare contingency plans in the briefing, and execute a decisive go-around ifan unstable approach occurs; Ifthe drop rate exceeds 1000 feet, the PM must issue a warning. ②During operation, ifthe altitude profile ishigher than expected after visual check, stabilize the descent point, then check the descent rate. If the rate is within 1000 feet per minute, continue the approach; otherwise, return tothe runway. ③ Xiamen now requires that both the covered bridge and passenger elevators must be removed and fully prepared before reporting. On the Xiamen-Nanyang route, the flight sequence may be directed as follows: QO, then P48, followed by P263, JDZ, and finally XSH.

上海虹桥.source_text_en: SASAN Point Merge procedure: inner arc (ESBAG direction) altitude ≥5400 m; outer arc (PIMOL/ZJ direction) altitude ≤5100 m; speed limit AT 260 kt.Aircraft on SS603-SASAN shall not deviate east of track without clearance; when airspace restrictions apply, descend to 3600 m–4800 m prior to 15 KM from SASAN.

上海虹桥.source_text_en: Hongqiao Airport will implement the Taxiway A / K1 Junction Supplementary Pavement Renovation Project. During Phases 1 and 2 (planned 1 September 2026 – 31 October 2026), flights parked/serviced inthe East Area thatfail tovacate via Taxiway A2 in a timely manner will have to taxi back via Taxiways B3 and B2 along Taxiway B, crossing the east runway via H4; or via Taxiway B1 along H2 and Taxiway C, crossing the west runway via H4, then Taxiway B and the east runway to return.

上海虹桥.source_text_en: Regarding the Visual Docking Guidance System (VDGS/A-VDGS) at Hongqiao Airport bridges: as the aircraftapproaches the stop line,the distance readout decreases rapidly and may suddenly jump to "STOP." Crews should control the docking speed—within the last 10 m, control speed so that "SLOW" does not appear on the guidance display; within the last5 m, ensure the aircraft can be stopped at any time to avoid crossing the stop line.
